How Solar And Wind Are Causing Electricity Prices To Skyrocket

The problem is exactly that you can't just whip up a power station turbine run by coal/natural gas. You have to heat the water, pressurize the steam boilers, and THEN you can start using the steam to turn the turbine. Depending on the size of the turbines (and the ones used in electrical power plants are pretty darn big), this can take 3-4 hours to get up to full generation.

So, what electrical companies do is to bring the boilers down to about 85-90% capacity during the day for solar, during high winds for windmills, so that when the wind dies down or the sun goes down, they can power up quickly.

So, you have cut 10-15% (in some older plants, they are only dropped to 95%, so savings is only 5%) in coal/gas and then are kicking in 30-40% of needs with solar and wind. That's 125-135% of your needs. You can't exactly STORE electricity, so it just goes to waste if not used. So, by adding more solar and wind than you can bring down the steam-driven turbine plants is just a waste. So you get to pay 135% of 100%. It's really rather stupid.
